_comment: ag3s-verifier (T46e-D). numbers and paths only. classification_rules were written 2026-10-13 11:02 KST before any T46e-D measurement and are not changed afterwards.

classification_rules.R0_chunks: 8 chunks = heldout162 chunks where off, F1, F1GT have 0 collision rows and ORV (oracle, identity pipeline) has rows: C1a_ep110_s1101:17, C1a_ep110_s1102:16, C1a_ep110_s1102:17, C1a_ep110_s1102:18, C1a_ep11_s111:12, C1a_ep123_s1231:13, C1a_ep3_s32:27; plus C1a_ep110_s1101:18 (off 53 -> ORV 123). Variants rebuilt with the V-T46e harness (t46e_vreplay.py logic, unchanged).
classification_rules.R1_responsible_voxel: for each ORV collision row (classify_violations keep_rows, class == collision): the responsible voxel = the remaining seed (main fine value == 0 and not in the variant's removed set) nearest (Euclidean, voxel centre) to the row's sphere centre, in the layer the row answered: target_free / target_free_coarse tier -> the variant's rebuilt fine target-free layer; any other tier -> the recorded main fine layer (main == 0). Plane / candidate rows are reported by block, not attributed to a voxel.
classification_rules.R2_gt_class: GT scene = planning-row qpos of that seq (MuJoCo, checkout model_transport.xml). Signed surface distance from the voxel centre to: target fruit (convex hull of its _vis mesh), each other fruit (hull of _vis mesh) -> 'neighbour_fruit', crate (union of its box geoms), table (table_top + legs boxes) -> 'table', shelf (boxes), robot (convex hull of each robot mesh geom within 0.3 m; inside = 0), room (floor plane z=0 world + office box geoms). class = argmin of these signed distances; d_geom = that minimum (mm).
classification_rules.R3_category: d_geom <= 5.0 mm (1 fine voxel): if class == target -> 'target_surface_kept', else 'preserved_<class>' (normal obstacle preservation). d_geom > 5.0 mm -> 'error_candidate' (sub-label = nearest class). Primary threshold 5.0 mm fixed; counts at 2.5 mm and 10.0 mm reported as sensitivity only.
classification_rules.R4_row_level: every row gets the category of its responsible voxel; counts reported per chunk both per row and per unique voxel. Rows also present in off (same step, query) are flagged.
classification_rules.R5_error_subcauses: for error_candidate voxels (numbers only): nearest oracle memory sample to the voxel (distance, code, update index -> planning seq, age = chunk seq - sample seq, whether that planning row was a HOLD i.e. ipc != ok or safe is False); d_t and d_o of oracle_visible_split; voxel z - z_floor; band mask bits of the voxel's band cell; for each camera of the chunk's own planning row and of the sample's planning row: rendered depth at the voxel's projection minus the voxel's camera depth (mm) and the code seen at that pixel; distance of the nearest memory sample to the GT surface of its own code's object (back-projection error, mm); pose_error_mm (renderer, per planning row and max); oracle record applied and identity_matches_gt.
classification_rules.R6_other_variants: for each responsible voxel: removed by off / F1 / F1GT / ORVgt (bool). For each chunk: seeds removed by off (and by F1, F1GT) that ORV keeps, by R2 class / R3 category.
classification_rules.R7_B2_support_layer: over all 162 heldout chunks: S = (off_removed AND F1GT_removed) minus ORV_removed with 0 <= z_centre - z_min < 10 mm (z_min = recorded ball z_min, base frame). S' = S minus voxels with target hull distance <= 5 mm or other-fruit hull distance <= 5 mm (V-T46e kept_vs_off definition). Reported: signed distance of S / S' voxel centres to the table geom (table_top box, mm; distribution and histogram), number of ORV collision rows whose responsible voxel is in S / S', and for those rows the sphere centre's signed distance to table_top minus sphere radius (mm).
classification_rules.R8_ORV_S_neighbour_seeds: ORV_S (diagnostic variant of V-T46e, same rule) removed seeds with other-fruit hull distance <= 5 mm (V-T46e count 3,627 over 162 chunks): R2 class and d_geom of each, split by whether the seed came from the ORV_S support-layer addition or from ORV itself, plus their table distance.
